svg.aria-label: Bento, or your own language, node graph, or material graph, builds Bento IR, which is lowered to SPIR-V for Vulkan 1.0 to 1.4 and OpenGL 4.5 to 4.6, DXIL for DirectX 12, AIR for Metal 3 and 4, and GLSL for OpenGL 4.5 to 4.6 and OpenGL ES 3.1 to 3.2 as a fallback for OpenGL drivers without SPIR-V support
